text:
incident-bot: Pager: high error rate (5xx) and timeouts on /v1/generate in prod-us-east-1. p95 4.8s -> 9.4s, p99 8.1s -> 18.2s, 5xx rate 3.9%. Paging @devon_oncall. Link: <https://alerts/dashboard|alerts>

devon_oncall: On it. grabbing traces and the most recent deploy id. @maria_sre fyi.

devon_oncall: Deploy ID: `deploy-2026-03-17-18:22` (service backend-gateway). Observed spike immediately after cutover. Rolling back now?

maria_sre: Seeing gateway 502/504s and a lot of `context_deadline_exceeded` in proxy logs. KV cache hit rate dropped ~30%. Could be kvcache warmup.

priya_prodeng: Customer-impact? Any top customers affected? @jordan_support can you pull support queue?

jordan_support: Two enterprise customers reported degraded responses on chat flows. Ticket IDs #1342, #1343. They're seeing timeouts >10s.

devon_oncall: Mitigation plan:
1) Route traffic to previous revision (rollback).
2) Increase replica count for backend-gateway to drain queues.
3) Enable prefix caching for heavy routes.
Rolling back now (step1).

incident-bot: Deploy rollback started: rollback job `789abc`. Expected cutover in ~30s.

maria_sre: Investigating root cause: heavier than usual batch sizes? Looking at request histograms: average seq len up slightly. Also `connect_timeout` spikes on internal grpc to model-hosts.

ryan_platform: I can bump connection pool and reenable keepalives for the gateway — doing now.

devon_oncall: Rollback complete. Traffic stable. p95 down to 1.2s, p99 2.8s, 5xx back to baseline 0.1%.

priya_prodeng: :white_check_mark: Good. @jordan_support please notify impacted customers and update status page.

jordan_support: Will send update within 10m. Logging postmortem runbook link: https://redwood/runbooks/timeout-deploy-regression

maria_sre: Follow-ups: add a canary traffic ramp (10% over 10m) for gateway deploys; add KV warmup hook; add alert for KV hit rate drop. Filing issues.

devon_oncall: Thanks team. Closing pager. final note: correlation id for problematic deploy: `deploy-2026-03-17-18:22`. Will include in postmortem.
